:::{#def-squared-error-risk}
#### Squared-error risk (expected prediction error)

The **squared-error risk** of a [prediction function](#def-prediction-function) $\predfnf{\Predvar}$,
also called its **expected prediction error** [@hastie2009elements, p. 18],
is the expected square of its [prediction error](#def-prediction-error):

$$\popriskf{\predfn} \eqdef \E{\sqf{\prederrf{\predfn}}}$$

:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#exm-squared-error-risk}
#### Squared-error risk in the best-predictor exercise

In @exr-best-predictor,
consider the constant [prediction](#def-prediction) $\predfn_1\paren{\Predvar} = 3$.
Its [squared-error risk](#def-squared-error-risk) is $\popriskf{\predfn_1} = 5$.

:::
